feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: ICE shooting in NYC fuels tension between New York officials and Trump administration
entry.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement shot a man in New York City. It raised tensions between the Trump administration and New York officials over the state's sanctuary policies.

entry.title: Major Hurricane Isaias takes aim on Gulf Coast
entry.summary: Hurricane Isaias in poised to make landfall on the Gulf Coast near the Alabama-Florida boarder. It will be the first hurricane to make landfall in the U.S. since 2024.

entry.title: How the beverage aisle got so wild
entry.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

entry.title: Mike Ditka, the legendary coach who led the Bears to a Superbowl, dies at 86
entry.summary: Hall of Fame football player and legendary coach Mike Ditka led the Chicago Bears to the team's only Superbowl in 1985. He died Friday at 86.

entry.title: Trump's Affordable Suit
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with New York Times fashion reporter Jacob Gallagher about President Trump's apparent choice to wear a suit from the budget menswear chain Jos. A. Bank.

entry.title: Despite the controversy, data centers could be attractive to struggling rural towns
entry.summary: There's lots of debate over data centers and where they should be located. In a struggling rural town data center development can look a lot more attractive.

entry.title: Twin Temple says blending Satanic lyrics and doo-wop 'transcends what's expected'
entry.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with the "Satanic doo-wop" duo Twin Temple about their new album Doomed Lovers and what drew them to Satanism and the occult.

entry.title: Political polls are everywhere, how much can they predict about November?
entry.summary: Midterm election polls are everywhere but how much can one data point tell about who will win in November?

entry.title: Taylor Swift is back at No. 1 on the charts
entry.summary: New songs added to her 2025 album The Life of a Showgirl has shot the release up the charts.

entry.title: Oil Platforms in the Gulf shut down in preparation for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Isaias is expected to make landfall as the season's first Atlantic hurricane. Oil rigs and refineries on the Gulf Coast are evacuating, but experts don't anticipate much of an impact on gas prices.
